text:
alex.dev: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — we need a concrete plan to reduce alert noise and lock owners/timelines. Main pain: infra-high-latency spikes are paging oncall every hour. Action items: audit noisy alerts, threshold sweep, dedupe/fingerprinting, paging policy updates. @maya_sre can you own the thresholds + dedupe experiments?

maya_sre: I can own dedupe + threshold tuning. Propose a 2-week experiment window with rollback points. I'll compile top noisy alerts and share a list by Thu. Will update runbooks with any changed signal semantics.

jamal-eng: I’ll take paging policy and routing changes (pager -> slack digest for low-sev, escalate for multi-trigger). Suggest: only page after 2 separate triggers within 15m for this class. I’ll draft the policy and a canary config.

tess-pm: Solid. Prioritize customer-impacting ones first (those with external tickets or >5 incidents in last 30d). Also want an SLO for alert volume so we can measure regressions post-change. I can draft the SLO proposal.

alex.dev: Proposed concrete plan: 1) maya: run noise audit (top-10 noisy alerts) + threshold sweep (INF-3245/INF-3246). 2) jamal: paging policy PR + canary (INF-3247). 3) maya+jamal: dedupe/fingerprint rules for duplicate symptoms. 4) tess: SLO + prioritization criteria. Timeline: quick triage by Fri, start experiments next Mon, 2-week window, rollback plan in 48h. Metrics to track: pager_count, mean time to ack, alert volume by rule, and customer incident count.

maya_sre: I created the audit ticket INF-3245 and threshold-experiments INF-3246. First pass of top-10 noisy alerts will be posted in this thread by Thu EOD. Will include suggested threshold deltas and rationales.

jamal-eng: Drafting paging policy now. Canary plan: apply to non-prod then 5% of prod routes for 48h, track missed-severity regressions. Will post PR link once ready.

oncall-bot: Reminder: runbook review meeting scheduled 2024-06-10 15:00 UTC — please add agenda items if you want the changes reviewed live.

tess-pm: For SLO proposal, thinking: reduce repeat noisy alerts by 60% within 30d post-change, and <20 active noisy alerts/week. I'll put numbers and KPIs in a google doc and link it.

alex.dev: Great. Next check-in: Mon 09:30 PST. Owners recap: maya_sre (dedupe/thresholds INF-3245/3246), jamal-eng (paging + runbook INF-3247), tess-pm (SLO & prioritization). I'll own the tracking doc and final signoff. Please ping me with PRs and data. :thumbsup:

jamal-eng: ack — starting policy PR now, will drop link here.

maya_sre: ack — first audit share by Thu, will include signal graphs + suggested deltas.

alex.dev: :rocket:
